Name: Forecast cycle
Description: Run the forecast action, then publish the forecast to the budget

Steps.Name: Forecast from run-rate
Steps.Description: Copy actuals into the forecast and uplift Q3

Steps.Name: Publish forecast

Name: Snapshot and lock a version
Description: Keep a private copy of a version, then lock the version so nobody changes it

Steps.Name: Private snapshot
Steps.Description: A private copy to keep working on

Steps.Name: Lock the version
Steps.Description: Planners and data actions can no longer write to it
